k_reset_q: All progress and records will be erased. This cannot be undone.
title: Void Delve
tagline: Three floors down. No way back.
help_move: Move with the left stick, the D-pad or WASD
help_aim: Aim and shoot with the right stick or the arrow keys
help_fire: Fire at the nearest enemy (touch fires by itself)
help_dash: Dash: you cannot be hit while dashing
help_bomb: Nova bomb: clears every bullet and hurts every enemy
help_use: Open chests and buy in the shop
help_relics: Relics stack: build a different weapon every run
help_meta: Essence from every run buys permanent upgrades in the Sanctum
tip_shoot: Aim with the right stick, or hold {0} to fire at the nearest enemy
tip_bomb: In trouble? {0} sets off a nova bomb
tip_shop: Stand on an item and press {0} to buy it with shards
tip_portal: Step into the portal to go deeper
tip_relic: Pick one relic: its power lasts for the whole run
tip_sanctum: Spend void essence on upgrades that last forever
m_vitality_d: +1 heart at the start of every run
m_agility_d: Faster movement and a shorter dash cooldown
m_relic_d: Start every run with a random relic
m_arsenal_d: +1 nova bomb at the start of every run
r_ricochet_d: Shots bounce off walls once more
r_pierce_d: Shots pass through one more enemy
r_drone_d: A drone circles you and hurts enemies
r_shrapnel_d: Enemies burst into shards that fly out
r_big_d: Bigger, harder shots, a little slower
r_magnet_d: Pulls shards from further, more shards
r_chain_d: Hits arc to two nearby enemies
r_phase_d: Dash recharges faster and hurts enemies
r_vamp_d: Heal a heart every few kills
r_overcharge_d: Every few shots is a triple-damage blast
r_angel_d: Come back once with two hearts
